en: Sepia-toned vintage image of a wide sandy beach with a long wooden pier or bathing pavilion on stilts extending over the shoreline. Small groups of people in old-fashioned clothing walk along the beach on the left, while a few small boats are visible in the sea on the right. In the distance are low hills or cliffs. The caption "BAPHA — VARNA" is printed in the upper left in Cyrillic and Latin letters.
